1 bodies
1 unbridgeable overhang(s); first at z = 28.0 mm, 41 mm²: best direction 115°, 67% of strands land on solid at both ends
a screw through the hole at +16.6 mm goes in only if the hole is at one end of where Dan's readings put it; no template or test print in the design would catch it
a 8 mm screw bottoms out 4.0 mm behind the board
the way in (12.0 x 12.0 mm) is smaller than the 14 x 8.5 mm opening that let a plug seat, and no print says whether a plug gets through it; no test print in the manual would catch it
the m3screw screw's insert has 3.10 mm of plastic: between 1.85, which bulged, and 3.85, which held
at least 16 mm clear above the perfboard
keyhole at (50, 75): its slot runs 180 degrees from straight up, so the piece can't drop onto the screw
none of the 6 screws that hold the box stands out of the back
